title: Country Up-and-Comer Greylan James Talks Viral Hit ‘Water at a Wedding,’ His New Album, And the Kenny Chesney Advice That Sparked His Career
line: Greylan James just scored his first Billboard Hot 100 hit with "Water at a Wedding" and is Billboard's Country Up-and-Comer for November. Somebody get him a bigger boat.

title: Cody Johnson Releases Special Acoustic Version Of “Take Me Back (And Leave Me There)”
line: Cody Johnson released a special acoustic version of "Take Me Back (And Leave Me There)." Same heart, fewer amps.

title: Country Music Hall Of Fame & Museum Celebrates Opening Of Roger Miller Exhibit
line: The Country Music Hall of Fame and Museum opened a new Roger Miller exhibit. Come see the king of the road.

title: Garth Brooks Announces Minnesota Dates For ‘Blame It All On My Roots Tour’
line: Garth Brooks added a pair of December shows in Minneapolis to his Blame It All On My Roots Tour. Friends in low places, now with mittens.

title: Wynonna Judd to Receive ASCAP Golden Note Award Honoring Her Legendary Career
line: Wynonna Judd will receive the ASCAP Golden Note Award honoring her career. That voice earned every note.

title: Cody Jinks Promises a Return to Country Roots on New Album “And, Again.”
line: Cody Jinks is promising a return to his country roots on his new album, "And, Again." Roots always grow back.

title: Johnny Owens Celebrates Buck Owens’ Christmas Legacy With “Santa Looked a Lot Like Daddy”
line: Johnny Owens is celebrating Buck Owens' Christmas legacy with "Santa Looked a Lot Like Daddy." Ho ho honky-tonk.

title: Watch Russell Dickerson's Adorable Gender Reveal For Baby No. 3
line: Russell Dickerson and his wife Kailey tried a brand-new kind of gender reveal for baby No. 3. Somebody get that baby a guitar.

title: Stella Lefty Is First Country Artist Since Taylor Swift To Perform At Capital's Jingle Bell Ball
line: Stella Lefty is the first country artist since Taylor Swift to perform at Capital's Jingle Bell Ball. That's some Swift company.

title: Randy Travis Will Be Honored at Grand Ole Opry for 40-Year Milestone
line: Randy Travis will be honored at the Grand Ole Opry for his 40-year milestone. Forty years and still going.

title: How To Purchase Dolly Parton’s New Holiday Collectible, ‘Dolly on the Holly’
line: Dolly Parton's new holiday collectible, a plush doll called 'Dolly on the Holly,' is now available at Walmart. Stocking stuffer, meet your queen.

title: Terri Clark Reveals Why She Has No Plans to Retire From Country Music Anytime Soon
line: Terri Clark says she has no plans to retire from country music anytime soon. Good, we're not done listening.

title: Wait, Gram Parsons Was Once Cast in a Sci-Fi Film?
line: A lost 1970 sci-fi film called 'Saturation 70' was meant to star Gram Parsons and country clothier Nudie Cohn. Rhinestones in space, anyone?

title: Jessica Chastain Premieres New Country Music Movie ‘Heartland’ in NYC, Explains Why She Won’t Be Singing on Broadway
line: Jessica Chastain premiered her new country music movie 'Heartland' in New York City and explained why she won't be singing on Broadway. The audience can relax.

title: Morgan Wallen’s “Sand In My Boots” Fest Ticket Prices are Ridiculous
line: Morgan Wallen announced his 'Sand In My Boots' festival returns to Gulf Shores, Alabama, after taking 2026 off. Pack sunscreen and a bigger wallet.

title: Ella Langley, Miranda Lambert, Cody Johnson & More Announced As Performers For 2026 CMA Awards
line: Ella Langley, Miranda Lambert and Cody Johnson are among the first performers named for the CMA Awards, live Nov. 18 on ABC with Lainey Wilson hosting solo. Set the DVR now.

title: Dolly Parton To Be Honored With Special Tribute During 60th CMA Awards — What To Know
line: Dolly Parton will get a special tribute at the 60th CMA Awards. Bring extra rhinestones.

title: Lainey Wilson Jokes She Has a Bedazzled Broom Ready for Ella Langley’s Potential CMA Awards Sweep
line: CMA host Lainey Wilson joked she has a bedazzled broom ready in case Ella Langley sweeps the awards. Cleanup on aisle country.

title: Kaitlin Butts drops 34-minute mini-movie to spotlight her new country music album 'Hello, Honky Tonk' | OutKick
line: Kaitlin Butts released a 34-minute mini-movie to spotlight her new album, 'Hello, Honky Tonk.' Popcorn pairs well with steel guitar.

title: Duck Hodges Gets Asked to Set Friends Up With Ella Langley
line: Former NFL quarterback Duck Hodges says his buddies keep asking him to set them up with Ella Langley, thanks to his wife's friendship with her. Good luck, fellas.

title: Tim McGraw, Sam Barber, Riley Green to headline 2027 Cavendish Beach Music Festival
line: Tim McGraw, Sam Barber and Riley Green will headline the 2027 Cavendish Beach Music Festival. Pack sunscreen and boots.

title: Tucker Wetmore Has Two Country Stars as His Lake Neighbors
line: Tucker Wetmore moved in near lake neighbors Dustin Lynch and Gary Allan, and things got a lot more fun. Hope the dock holds up.

title: Lady A to Host and Perform at ‘CMA Country Christmas’ 2026 Alongside Trisha Yearwood, Zach Top and More
line: Lady A will host and perform at 'CMA Country Christmas' on Tuesday, Dec. 1, alongside Trisha Yearwood and Zach Top. Santa's getting a steel guitar.

title: Country music legend Garth Brooks announces 10 Irish shows for 2027
line: Garth Brooks has announced 10 shows in Ireland for 2027. Ireland is about to get friends in low places.

title: “People Are So Easy To Walk Away” — Tim McGraw Opens Up On Success Of 30-Year Marriage To Faith Hill
line: Tim McGraw, inducted into the Country Music Hall of Fame on Oct. 18, talked about his 30-year marriage to Faith Hill, saying 'people are so easy to walk away.' That's a song worth singing.

title: What We Know About Randy Travis’ New Album, ‘Same Old Way’ (No, It’s Not AI)
line: Randy Travis' new album, 'Same Old Way,' comes out Nov. 13, and no, it's not AI. Some things stay real.

title: Stephen Wilson Jr. Reveals He Has No Memory of His ‘Stand By Me’ CMA Awards Performance
line: Stephen Wilson Jr. says he has no memory of his 'Stand By Me' CMA Awards performance and has never watched it. Hope somebody taped it.

title: Mickey Guyton to embark on "Mickey Guyton & Friends Holiday Tour"
line: Mickey Guyton is heading out on the 'Mickey Guyton & Friends Holiday Tour.' Jingle bells with a twang.

title: Craig Morgan Salutes Toby Keith, American Soldiers and the Music That Made Him on New Album 'My Country'
line: Craig Morgan salutes Toby Keith, American soldiers and the music that made him on his new album My Country. Flags and guitars, a good mix.

title: Quick-Thinking Dog Saves A Minnesota Homeowner From A Surprise Black Bear Encounter
line: Zeus the dog protected Minnesota homeowner Bailey Jacobson from a surprise black bear in her driveway. That's one very good boy.
